newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina expands 2003 global bond by $500 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina expands 2003 global bond by $500 mln.

text.p: Argentina has expanded its 2003 global bond by $500 million, replacing the planned 2004 global to have been issued last week, the Economy Ministry said Monday.
The $500 million expansion was priced at 185 basis points over similar dated U.S. Treasuries, the ministry said in a statement.

"This operation replaces the issuance of the new global bond maturing in 2004 that Argentina decided to delay given the fluctuations in international capital markets due to the problems in the economies of South East Asia," the statement said.
It added that the expansion of the 2003 issue will permit the bond to "eliminate the distortions it suffered in its price, and raise its liquidity restoring its benchmark condition."
The issue is part of the debt issuance budgeted for 1997.
